Our Annual Celebration

The President's Club

Coldwell Banker® Select and Coldwell Banker Plaza recognize our top producers each year, based solely on Gross Commission Income. Earn your award through your 2026 production — then celebrate it in paradise this January 2027.

The President's Club is your reward for the hard work you put into selling real estate. Award levels are tracked all year on your closed GCI — clear, simple, and entirely yours to earn.

Every award is paid as a check at the December sales meeting. We encourage you to put those funds toward your trip — it keeps your choice of room, extra nights, and future destinations flexible.

Rooms are reserved on a first-come, first-served basis. Once you submit your reservation, Jenny Miller — our travel agent — will confirm your room and arrange payment. With only 40 rooms, the best ones go quickly.

Every Coldwell Banker Select and Coldwell Banker Plaza agent is welcome. Earn your way, or reserve your own spot and join the celebration.

Your Reward

President's Club Award Levels

Awards are based on closed and estimated pending GCI through December 31, 2026. You must be with Coldwell Banker Select at the time the award is given to be eligible.

Eligibility requirement: Your Coldwell Banker company account balance must be paid in full — zeroed out to $0 — by December 1, 2026 to qualify for any award level. This refers to your brokerage account balance with the company, not your trip payment.

Before You Book

Good to Know

Airfare

Round-trip airfare to Punta Cana runs about $600 per person and is booked independently — it's your responsibility.

Booking your own flights lets you arrive early or extend your stay beyond January 28.

Airport Transfers

Round-trip transfers to and from the resort are about $36 per person.

Arrange your transfer through our travel agent when you submit your reservation — please don't book it separately.

Trip Insurance

Trip insurance is each traveler's responsibility and is not provided by Coldwell Banker Select or Coldwell Banker Plaza.

We strongly recommend it. Recommended providers will be shared closer to the trip.

Room Policies

  • Solo travelers pay the same total as two guests (full double-occupancy rate).
  • Bringing a guest? Your guest pays the same per-person rate you do. Airfare is the guest's responsibility.
  • Two double beds are very limited and not guaranteed — request them specifically through our travel agent.

Cancellation Policy

There are a limited number of rooms this year. Please review the timeline carefully before booking.

On or before September 15, 2026: Full refund
September 16 – October 15, 2026: 50% refund of total amount paid
After October 15, 2026: No refund
